content: उपाकरणम् .²1 An invitation to begin, bringing near; पवमान˚, प्रातरनुवाक˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 A term given to certain sentences called {%Praiṣas%} (with which one priest calls another to perform a sacrifice). .²3 Immolation, sacrifice of an animal consecrated according to rites. .²4 Preparation, beginning, commencement. .²5 Commencement of reading the Veda after the performance of the preparatory rite; <ab>cf.</ab> उपाकर्मन्; वेदोपाकरणाख्यं कर्म करिष्ये <ls>Śrāvaṇī Mantra.</ls>
